title: Saint Louis Chess Club - Videos
description: The Saint Louis Chess Club brings in a rotation of the top players in the country to fill the role of Resident Grandmaster. These top players present lectures to our Chess Club members each week, and we offer everything from kids and adult beginner classes to advanced lectures featuring in-depth Grandmaster analysis. We capture these lectures and share them on YouTube in an effort to make the game of chess more accessible, and more fun. Watch. Share. Enjoy!
